question: Are there any songs that Cat-sensei often listens to while writing Re? If so, I'd love to hear about them!
answer:
For some reason, when I'm writing, I tend to work with the idea of, “When I'm writing this volume, I'll keep this song on heavy rotation.”

It's usually about one song per volume, something that I happen to think sounds good at the time.

You can apparently write an entire book by looping one song around 8,000 times. (laughs)

Right now, I'm taking a break from writing, so I'm looking for songs that might suit the next volume. At the moment, I'm listening to “Atsumori 2011.”
